sources.title: NVIDIA Ships the Nemotron 3 Open-Weight Model Family
sources.snippet: Across GTC 2026 and the following months NVIDIA released the Nemotron 3 open-weights family, a hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts line from a 120B Super to a 550B Ultra, with open weights, data, and training recipes.

sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3: Efficient Open Agentic AI
sources.snippet: Implications and Future Outlook Nemotron 3's open, transparent release strategy—encompassing model weights, rich datasets (10T+ tokens), and pre-/post-training recipes—positions it for broad adoption in agentic, multi-modal, and long-context AI systems.
